entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi, Alex. I hope you can help me. I'm just so confused by everything. I bought this jersey a while ago and it's... it's just not right.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
A preference, I guess? I think I ordered the wrong size. When I tried it on, it was way too tight across the shoulders. The website was a bit overwhelming and I must have clicked the wrong thing.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. So it's a sizing issue, not a problem with the item itself. Let me just pull up your account. Can I have your name and order number?
The name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... oh dear... one moment... okay, it's VF8675309. I feel so helpless, I should have called sooner. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Ms. Jenkins, that's what I'm here for. No need to worry. Let's see... I have your order right here. It looks like the jersey was delivered 51 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy for you.
Alright, I've checked, and I have good news. You are well within our 90-day return window for apparel. We can absolutely set up an exchange for a different size or process a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it. I would love to do an exchange for the next size up, please.

Excellent. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and waived any return shipping fees. I am emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack up the jersey, put the label on the box, and we'll send out the new size as soon as we get the original back.
Wow, that's fantastic! You've made this so simple. Thank you so much for your help, Alex.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
